text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of a GⅠ race!
The crowd is unbelievable...!

"The 'Hanshin Juvenile Fillies' that I'm spectating with Almond Eye today
is a Junior-class GⅠ 1600m mile race."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Most of the Umamusume running in this race
are setting their sights on the Tiara route, aren't they?
choice_data_list: All the information's properly in there too.
All the information's properly in there too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I can't help but wonder... "What if I were the one running?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go check out the paddock!
I wonder what the atmosphere is like...!
Perhaps because it's a Junior Class GⅠ, it carries a somewhat fresher atmosphere compared to other GⅠ races that are thick with tension and frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's Lara!

Lucky Lilac was backed as the 2nd favorite today.
The 1st favorite had also won a graded stakes race, just like her.

text_block_list.name: Favorite Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Nice to work with you, Lala!
As fellow fans of Lord Orfe, let's do our best to get even a little closer to him!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I can get closer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Aye, that's right.
Please go easy on me, y'hear?

Sensing something bold and fearless beneath
Lucky Lilac's graceful, polite demeanor—
the race began.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: “—And now, which Umamusume will seize the generation's very first GⅠ title?!”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Lala is... around mid-pack, huh.
Considering how she usually runs, it feels a bit further back than usual, but...
choice_data_list: Still, that's a good position to break out from anywhere.
Still, that's a good position to break out from anywhere.

text_block_list.text:
In contrast to the race favorite who had already surged to the front,
Lucky Lilac was biding her time,
saving her strength...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
They're entering the final straight...!
Now, I wonder what Lala's next move will be—

The moment she muttered those words...
Lucky Lilac sprang into action.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here she comes on the outside! Lucky Lilac!
Lucky Lilac is mounting an attack!
She breaks through, she breaks through! Lucky Lilac!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Incredible, she's pulling away further and further—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Lucky Lilac!
Claiming the Junior crown,
she is the first to stake her claim at the top of her generation!
(Waaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the cheers, everyone.
Name's Lucky Lilac.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Please keep me in mind from now on—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Lara-san, that was a wonderful run.
It was well worth making the trip out here, right, Or?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. We are heading back, Sister.
You have made reservations at the steakhouse, I trust?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I've reserved a wonderful restaurant in Kobe.
Wait here a moment,
I'll have the car brought around.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san...
...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone, could I have a moment of your time? There is something I wish to share with you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "I, Lucky Lilac... will claim the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
First, at the Oka Sho,
allow me to show you how a lilac blooms.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Crowned in a golden radiance...
I shall prove myself as the star of the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Standing side by side with my idol.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Oka Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! After the Shinzan Kinen—
please let me move on to the Oka Sho!
The Oka Sho that Almond Eye hoped for. Just as Lucky Lilac declared—
choice_data_list: (The first leg of the Triple Tiara...)

text_block_list.text:
"The Classic Triple Crown route, including the Nippon Derby
which decides the strongest of the generation, had long been seen as the premier path.
However, in recent years—"
"Umamusume from the Tiara route have also been widely successful, generating massive excitement. For instance—"
Gentildonna, the newest Triple Tiara Umamusume. She is a 7-time Turf GⅠ-winning Umamusume who even defeated the great Orfevre.

If Almond Eye can follow
after that—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara?
Yes, it would be an immense honor if I could be crowned!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Still, hmm... Saying that I'm 'aiming' for it might be slightly off."

I had assumed she decided on the Oka Sho
inspired by Lucky Lilac's Triple Tiara declaration,
but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to race that girl...
I want to race Lala!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You saw that final burst of speed too, didn't you?
It was almost as if she took flight...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—My blood is pumping!
I just want to beat her... so badly...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So... can what comes after the Oka Sho
wait until after I beat Lala?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even if I go for the Oaks next
and aim for the Triple Tiaraâ
choice_data_list: ...Whether we go for the Shuka Sho depends on how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm sorry for being stubborn.
But please, I'm counting on you!

Almond Eye is not bound by records.
She simply—follows her own heart.

And so, the main goal of the Classic Year was set.
The first leg of the Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho...
Just what kind of future will her feelings lead her to—
